items.title: Ross Stores Grew Comparable Sales 10%. TJX Grew 4%. Only One Stock Went Up.
items.summary: The two off-price giants reported the same 13 weeks, a day apart. The market read them very differently -- and the second-half plans say why.

items.title: TJX (TJX) Stock Gets Fair Value Trim As Analysts Weigh Guidance Against Marmaxx Risks
items.summary: The analyst fair value estimate for TJX Companies has shifted from $177.63 to $172.80, pointing to a slightly more cautious price target in the latest update. This move lines up with mixed Street commentary, where bullish analysts point to earnings guidance and portfolio strength, while bearish views highlight softer Marmaxx comps, tougher competition, and near term execution risk. items.title: How Much Track Is Left For ROST Stock?
items.summary: After a brief pre-earnings pullback, Ross Stores' swift recovery is forcing investors to decide if its business turnaround is already fully priced into the stock.

items.title: Ross Stores Just Flipped the Off-Price Retail Story After TJX's Marmaxx Miss
items.summary: Ross Stores stock jumped about 8% after Q2 2026 earnings beat estimates and guidance was raised, easing concerns raised a day earlier by TJX Companies' weaker outlook.

items.title: Advance Auto Parts Plunged, But Its Turnaround Is Still Working
items.summary: Advanced Auto Parts stock fell after weak DIY sales in Q2, but improving margins, cash flow, and analyst and institutional support suggest the decline may be a buying opportunity.

items.title: Ross Jumps 8% on 10% Comp Growth, TJX Ticks Up, Macy’s Edges Higher
items.summary: Ross Stores gapped up sharply Friday while the rest of retail sat still, and the reason behind that split tells you everything about where the consumer is hiding right now.

items.title: TJX beats Q2 expectations despite ‘self-inflicted’ apparel slump
items.summary: TJX Companies beat its own expectations for the second quarter of fiscal 2027 (Q2 FY27), posting a 4% increase in consolidated comparable store sales that offset a sluggish performance in its core apparel division.
